title: @inth/sdk-iab: IAB TCF 2.4 and GPP Addon
description: IAB TCF 2.4 and Global Privacy Platform (GPP) addon for Inth with TC String and GPP string generation, GVL support, TCF and GPP APIs, and programmatic advertising consent workflows.
features: IAB TCF 2.4 support for programmatic advertising consent
IAB GPP 1.1 API (`__gpp`) with US state, MSPA US National and TCF EU sections through `@inth/sdk-iab/gpp`
Purpose, special purpose, feature, special feature, and vendor controls
Headless APIs for custom IAB consent experiences
prerequisites: Use [Inth](https://inth.com) for a hosted IAB TCF-certified CMP setup with a managed CMP ID, or register your own CMP with IAB Europe and configure your own CMP ID
manualInstallation: For React UI components, use the @inth/react IAB subpath and stylesheet:
usage: Configure Inth with the IAB consent model for jurisdictions that require TCF workflows
Use the React IAB components for a prebuilt TCF banner and preference center
Use headless APIs when you need a custom IAB consent experience
Use `createGPP` from `@inth/sdk-iab/gpp` to signal US state opt-outs and GPC to ad tech; see the [IAB GPP docs](https://c15t.com/docs/frameworks/javascript/gpp)
For full implementation details, see the [IAB TCF 2.4 docs](https://c15t.com/docs/frameworks/react/iab)

customSections.Related Packages:
- [@inth/react](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@inth/react): React IAB consent banner, dialog, and hooks through @inth/react/iab
- [@inth/sdk](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@inth/sdk): the consent engine with this IAB TCF support
